name: Leeway
subtitle: Offline sea charts and passage planning

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Leeway shows your position on the chart and records your track.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Leeway keeps recording your track while the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Leeway connects to your boat's instruments and AIS over Wi-Fi, and can use a data server on board.
